# Example
# Further Example

> When the clouds arrived, ten times the square root of a flock of swans flew to Lake Manasa, while one-eighth of the flock flew from the water's edge to a grove of land-lotuses. O girl, three pairs of swans were seen enjoying themselves in the water, which was lovely with young lotus stalks. Tell me the total number of the flock. (3)

**Prose order:** O girl! With the arrival of the clouds, ten times the square root of the flock of swans went to Lake Manasa. One-eighth of the flock flew from the water's edge to a land-lotus grove. And three pairs of swans were seen enjoying play in the water, adorned with young lotus stalks. If so, tell me the total number of the flock. (3)

**Meaning:** O beloved, who is sixteen years of age! There was a flock of swans. When the rainy season arrived, ten times the square root of them went to Lake Manasa, and one-eighth of the flock flew from the water's edge to the land-lotus grove. And three pairs <note>6 swans</note> of swans were seen playing with great affection in the water, which was beautiful with soft lotus stalks. Tell me, how many swans were in that flock? (3)

**Calculation:** The multiplier is 10. The fraction is 1/8. The visible amount is 6. Since the rule states "reduced by the fraction," here, by dividing the visible amount 6 by the remaining fraction 7/8, we obtain the visible amount 48/7. The multiplier becomes 80/7. Half of the multiplier is 40/7. Squaring this gives 1600/49. Adding this to the visible amount gives 1936/49. The square root of this is 44/7. Added to half the multiplier (40/7) and squared, the total number of swans is 144.

**Elaboration:** According to the rule mentioned in the second verse above, when one-eighth (1/8) is subtracted from one, it becomes 1/1 - 1/8 = 7/8. Dividing the visible amount of 6 by this, we get 6/1 ÷ 7/8 = 6/1 × 8/7 = 48/7. By adjusting the seven, 48/7 becomes the visible quantity. Similarly, dividing the multiplier 10 by 7/8, we get 10/1 ÷ 7/8 = 10/1 × 8/7 = 80/7. By adjusting the seven, 80/7 becomes the base quantity. Now, taking 48/7 as the visible quantity and 80/7 as the base, the operation is performed according to the method stated in the verse above. That is, half of the multiplier is 40/7. Squaring this gives 1600/49. This is added to the visible quantity 48/7...
